protocol.expansionGate: Preserve the original pilot gate and failed scores. A repair over the previous report is a mechanism improvement, not superiority to equivalent direct checks. A tie with direct checks does not open broader scope.
protocol.gold: Set admission and issue-subject requirements from the pinned consumer contracts and mutation targets, never observed evaluator output. The root-layout case selects the 21 semantic route IDs from the web graph that explicitly require the removed runtime context.
protocol.linkRule: Every required error subject must have a before or after declared impact path whose first record is the actual changed mapping ID and whose last record is the error subject. The mapping record identifies its producer; the producer must have the same changed-mapping origin. One-node failure paths do not satisfy this rule. Metadata controls and equivalent replacement must introduce no errors.

methods.direct: Same compiler, gates, packs and explicit inputs, stable-ID diff and compileMetamap impact separately seeded with each actual changed graph record. Direct checks have equivalent dependency-path information.
